◊Legal Disclaimers

Accessories: Accessories are sold separately; availability varies by region.

Apple Intelligence and Siri AI: Apple Intelligence is available with Siri and device language set to Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish or Vietnamese. Some features may not be available in all regions or languages. Siri AI is available in beta in macOS 27 and requires an Apple Intelligence–enabled device set to a supported language. Available in English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish to start. Siri AI will not be initially available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS. Siri AI is not available for users under 13. Certain Apple Intelligence features that rely on server-side models are subject to daily usage limits, including but not limited to Siri AI, Intelligent Photo Editing Tools, Image Playground and AFM 3 Cloud models in Shortcuts. Daily limits may vary by feature, request complexity, system demand, system policies and other factors. Expanded access to such features will be available for a fee in the future. Use of these features is subject to the Apple Intelligence Terms and Conditions. Learn more at support.apple.com/en-in/148587.

Apps: Apps shown may be available on the App Store; some software may be sold separately. Some apps and services may require a subscription.

Display: Screen sizes are 33.74 cm / 13.3″ (13″ MacBook Pro with M1 or M2), 35.97 cm / 14.2″ (14″ MacBook Pro) and 41.05 cm / 16.2″ (16″ MacBook Pro). Measured diagonally as a standard rectangular shape. Actual viewable area is less due to rounded corners at the top.

FaceTime: FaceTime calling requires a FaceTime-enabled device for the caller and recipient, and a Wi-Fi connection. Availability over a cellular network depends on carrier policies; data charges may apply.

Feature, App and Service Availability: Features are subject to change. Some features, applications and services may not be available in all regions or languages.

iCloud+: Subscription is required. The Apple TV subscription included with iCloud+ does not include third-party branded subscription services or content available for rental or purchase in the Apple TV app. Some iCloud features require a Wi-Fi connection and are not available in all countries or regions. Access to some services is limited to 10 devices.

iPhone Mirroring: Available on Mac computers with Apple silicon and Intel-based Mac computers with a T2 Security Chip. Requires that your iPhone and Mac are signed in with the same Apple Account using two-factor authentication, your iPhone and Mac are near each other and have Bluetooth and Wi-Fi turned on, and your Mac is not using AirPlay or Sidecar. Some iPhone features (e.g. camera and microphone) are not compatible with iPhone Mirroring.

Power and Battery: Battery life varies by use and configuration. See apple.com/in/batteries for more information.

Storage: Actual formatted capacity of SSD storage is less.

Thunderbolt Ports: Port configuration varies by model.

Up to 11.6x Faster than M1 Max: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using production 14″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M5 Max, 18-core CPU, 40-core GPU and 128GB of unified memory, as well as production 14″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M4 Max, 16-core CPU, 40-core GPU and 128GB of unified memory, and production 14″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M1 Max, 10-core CPU, 32-core GPU and 64GB of unified memory, all configured with 8TB SSD. Time to first token measured with an 8K-token prompt using a 14-billion parameter model with 4-bit quantisation, and LM Studio v0.4.25+1. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of MacBook Pro.

Up to 4 More Hours of Battery Life than the 13″ MacBook Pro with M1 or M2: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production 14″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, 32GB of unified memory and 1TB SSD. Wireless web battery life tested by browsing 25 popular websites while connected to Wi-Fi. Video streaming battery life tested with 1080p content in Safari while connected to Wi-Fi. Display brightness set to 8 clicks from the bottom and keyboard backlight was off. Battery life varies by use, configuration and environmental factors. See apple.com/in/batteries for more information.

Up to 10.9x Faster than M1 Pro: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using production 16″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M5 Pro, 18-core CPU, 20-core GPU and 64GB of unified memory, as well as production 16″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M4 Pro, 14-core CPU, 20-core GPU and 48GB of unified memory, both configured with 4TB SSD; and production 16″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M1 Pro, 10-core CPU, 16-core GPU and 32GB of unified memory, configured with 8TB SSD. Time to first token measured with an 8K-token prompt using a 14-billion parameter model with 4-bit quantisation, and LM Studio v0.4.25+1. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of MacBook Pro.

Up to 13x Faster than M1 and up to 13x Faster AI Performance than the 13″ MacBook Pro with M1 or M2: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production 14″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, 32GB of unified memory and 4TB SSD, as well as production 13″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M1, 8-core CPU, 8-core GPU, 16GB of unified memory and 2TB SSD. Time to first token measured with a 16K-token prompt using a 14-billion parameter model with 4-bit quantisation, and LM Studio v0.4.25+1. Performance tests are conducted using specific computer systems and reflect the approximate performance of MacBook Pro.

Up to 24 Hours of Battery Life: Testing conducted by Apple in September 2026 using pre-production 14″ MacBook Pro systems with Apple M6, 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, 32GB of unified memory and 1TB SSD. Wireless web battery life tested by browsing 25 popular websites while connected to Wi-Fi. Video streaming battery life tested with 1080p content in Safari while connected to Wi-Fi. Display brightness set to 8 clicks from the bottom and keyboard backlight was off. Battery life varies by use, configuration and environmental factors. See apple.com/in/batteries for more information.

Wi-Fi 7: Wi-Fi 7 availability varies by country. For more information, visit support.apple.com/en-in/148165.
